sloka: पुन्नाम्नो नरकाद्यस्मात् पितरं त्रायते सुत: ।तस्मात् पुत्र इति प्रोक्त: पितऽन् यत्पाति वा सुत: ॥ २.१०७.१२॥
transliteration: punnāmno narakādyasmāt pitaraṁ trāyate suta: ।tasmāt putra iti prokta: pita'n yatpāti vā suta: ॥ 2.107.12॥

translations.english: Putra is so called as he delivers his father from a hell known as Put and protects the ancestors in all possible ways.
